projects.name: UniPty
projects.description: Runtime-neutral PTY for Node, Bun, and Deno — one public contract, developer-selectable Backends, evidence-gated support claims.
projects.descriptionZh: 运行时中立的 PTY 库，面向 Node、Bun 与 Deno —— 一份公共契约、开发者可选择的 Backend、以证据门控的支持声明。

projects.name: OpenSpecUI
projects.description: The web UI companion for OpenSpec-driven development — serve, preview, and export spec-driven projects with one command.
projects.descriptionZh: OpenSpec 驱动开发的 Web UI 伴侣 —— 一条命令即可服务、预览并导出规范驱动的项目。

projects.name: jixoai/ui
projects.description: The jixoai design language as a shadcn registry: terminal aesthetics, the OKLCH one-hue law, and mono-first components you own after copying.
projects.descriptionZh: 以 shadcn registry 形式发布的 jixoai 设计语言：终端美学、OKLCH 单色相法则、拷贝即所有的 mono-first 组件。

projects.name: OpenTray
projects.description: Desktop status runtime for CLI and AI-skill ecosystems — tray-first apps running on Node, Bun, and Deno.
projects.descriptionZh: 面向 CLI 与 AI skill 生态的桌面状态运行时 —— 托盘优先的应用，跑在 Node、Bun 与 Deno 上。

projects.name: OpenDWeb
projects.description: Application-level networking platform: multi-device applications form invite-based logical networks over QUIC direct links with self-hostable relay fallback.
projects.descriptionZh: 应用级组网平台：让多设备应用组成逻辑网络 —— 像游戏房间而非系统级 VPN，QUIC 直连优先、可自托管 Relay。

projects.name: OpenIWeb
projects.description: Open-source personal application node — an AI coding agent deploys and operates apps on your own node through MCP; the owner manages everything with one key.
projects.descriptionZh: 面向普通人的开源个人应用节点：不懂容器与运维也能自托管，把 MCP 端点与一把密钥交给 AI 编程代理即可部署运维。
